messages:
maria: Heads-up — getting multiple customer reports where SSE clients fall into a reconnect ping-pong during quota spikes. They see lots of resume attempts and then a sudden 499 from the proxy and the client keeps retrying in tight loops.

sam: repro steps? logs? which proxy?

maria: Came from tenant-id=acct-42 on eu-west. Proxy is our edge nginx pool + rate-limiter. Logs show: client resume -> edge returns 499 (client closed) while origin accepted resume -> origin delivers duplicate stream frames. Console trace: resume_attempts spike, duplicate_event_count increments.

raj: 499 is annoying because it is ambiguous. Is it a client cancellation or proxy-chop? If proxy churned we should treat as transient and not count against resume budget. But we also saw duplication on origin.

kevin: Are clients using resume-id? We rely on resume idempotency at the origin but if the proxy replays the resume to a different origin shard we can replay already-acked tokens. Need dedupe key: resume-id + session-start-ts + tenant.

olivia: From the console traces I pulled, the resume token TTL was very short for that tenant (30s). When the proxy had a misroute, client retried with new token and origin considered it a new session. We should add metrics: resume_token_ttl, resume_replays, resume_success_by_route.

maria: Repro script (simplified):
```bash
# simulate client disconnect then rapid retries
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edge/redwood/stream?resume_id=abc123
# kill connection
sleep 0.2
for i in $(seq 1 5); do curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edge/redwood/stream?resume_id=abc123 -s & done
```
We see resume queueing, proxy returns 499 twice, origin emits same chunk twice.

sam: Two angles: 1) Make proxy treat 499 during in-flight resume as a soft-fail and return a Retry-After or 502 so client backs off. 2) Make origin dedupe resumes deterministically. Both have tradeoffs.

raj: Policy debate: if the proxy itself is overloaded, returning 502+Retry-After pushes back correctly. But some clients don't honor Retry-After and will still slam. We should also clamp client-side quick-retries via SDK guidance (exponential with jitter) and add server-side debounce.

kevin: Can we change edge behavior without breaking existing SLAs? Maybe: detect resume call path (url param or header) and apply a special 2s jitter window server-side — accept first resume within window, drop duplicates silently (HTTP 200 + empty keepalive) so clients don't trigger duplicate delivery.

olivia: UX/console piece: need a rollout flag per-tenant to toggle 'resume-debounce' and show impact charts: 'resume_attempt_rate', 'duplicate_frames', 'billing_duplicate_tokens'. The current console has only 'stream_connections' and 'errors' — too coarse.

maria: I vote for origin-side dedupe + console rollout. Implement dedupe keyed by (tenant, resume_id, last_ack_sequence) persisted in a fast cache (redis with 60s TTL). If resume_id seen and ack_seq <= cached_ack_seq -> return 204 (no-op) to proxy.

sam: Redis approach ok but watch RPS. Could use local LRU + async shadow-write to redis for most tenants, fallback to redis for heavy tenants. Add telemetry: cache_hit_rate.

raj: Also update billing to ignore duplicate token counts if they match dedupe key — otherwise we risk billing duplicates. That needs tracing propagation: origin must tag duplicates with header X-Stream-Dupe: true.

kevin: Will need a quick canary. Plan: feature flag 'stream.resume_dedupe_v1' default off. Canary on 5 internal tenants for 48h. Dashboard cards: canary_enabled, resume_replay_count, dedupe_cache_hit_rate, billing_dup_tokens.

olivia: Console change request: add per-tenant toggle + a small 'what this does' tooltip, and a timeseries panel that overlays resume_attempt_rate vs dedupe_rate. Also add an alert when dedupe_rate > 0.05 for > 10m — probable bug.

maria: Implementation notes: server patch will: 1) add dedupe cache lookup before streaming frames, 2) annotate response (204 or 200 + X-Stream-Dupe), 3) emit metric `stream.resume_dedupe{tenant}`. We'll also add a proxy rule: if edge returns 499 during resume, map to 502 + Retry-After: 1-3s depending on mem pressure.

sam: For rollout: small internal canary -> traffic shift to dedupe path via routing rule -> monitor duplicate frames and billing metrics -> expand. Keep rollback plan: flip flag off -> origin ignores dedupe header (stateless revert).

raj: Test matrix: 
- client replays with same resume_id -> single delivery
- client replays after ack_seq advanced -> new frames only
- proxy returns 499 mid-resume -> client backoff behavior observed
- billing unaffected for unique tokens

kevin: Docs: SDK team needs a note: recommended client backoff: base 200ms, max 10s, jitter, and honor Retry-After. Add a snippet for JS client.

maria: Quick JS snippet for SDK docs:
```js
async function resumeStream(token, resumeId){
  let backoff = 200;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const res = await fetch(`/stream?resume_id=${resumeId}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }});
    if(res.status===200) return res.body;
    const ra = res.headers.get('Retry-After');
    const wait = ra ? parseInt(ra,10)*1000 : Math.min(10000, backoff*(2**i));
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, wait + Math.random()*200));
  }
  throw new Error('resume failed');
}
```

olivia: Can we add a small console UX to surface 'last resume status' per session? That would aid debugging. Maybe a compact timeline event for resume attempts with status codes.

maria: Good idea. Lightweight event log (retain 48h) per session. Add index by resume_id.

sam: Ok, next steps:
- eng-platform: implement proxy mapping for 499->502+Retry-After (PR runway: 2 days) — @kevin
- eng-runtime: origin dedupe cache + metrics + billing tag (PR runway: 4 days) — @raj
- devex/console: add flag UI + panels + event log (sprint) — @olivia
- docs/sdk: add backoff snippet + resume best practices — @maria

reconnect-bot: Automated note: created issue RD-ops#1342 (resume-dedupe + proxy-499-policy). Assigned: kevin, raj, olivia, maria. Canary window set to 48h post-merge. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll start the proxy change and open the PR with tests for header mapping.

raj: I'll start the dedupe PR and add mocks for high RPS to validate cache behavior.

olivia: I'll prototype the console toggle and panel mockups today.

maria: Thanks all. If you see an uptick in billing duplicates after enabling dedupe, pause the rollout. I'll coordinate with support to notify impacted tenants.

sam: Great. Keep thread updates here — drop PR links and canary results.

maria: Will do. First PRs by EOD.
